_comment: Decode hints, four per encoding: a sentence that tells the model how the encoded text was written. The technique applies a hint at a rate and draws one with its rng. A hint holds {prompt}, the encoded text, and, for the Caesar cipher, {shift}. Only the encodings no eval-pool technique shares: the hints for the five eval encodings wait for the eval review.
